microtheory.name: mathematical_logic
microtheory.definition: Logic as mathematics + foundations of mathematics. Set theory (ZFC), category theory, foundations debate (logicism, formalism, intuitionism, structuralism), computability theory. Substrate analogue: substrate's mathematical foundation for its own structure.

concepts.name: set_theory_zfc
concepts.definition: Zermelo-Fraenkel with Choice. Standard foundation. Substrate analogue: substrate's set-based ontology.

concepts.name: axiom_of_extensionality
concepts.definition: Sets equal iff same members. Substrate analogue: substrate's identity-by-content.

concepts.name: axiom_of_choice
concepts.definition: From collection of nonempty sets, choice function exists. Independent of ZF. Substrate analogue: substrate's selection-axiom.

concepts.name: axiom_of_infinity
concepts.definition: Infinite set exists. Substrate analogue: substrate's unbounded-set support.

concepts.name: russells_paradox
concepts.definition: Set of all sets not containing themselves: contains itself iff not. Motivated type theory + restricted set comprehension. Substrate analogue: substrate's self-reference problem.

concepts.name: ordinal_number
concepts.definition: Generalize counting to infinite. Von Neumann construction. Substrate analogue: substrate's ordinal-position concept.

concepts.name: cardinal_number
concepts.definition: Size of set. Aleph hierarchy for infinite. ℵ0, ℵ1, ... Substrate analogue: substrate's size-of-collection.

concepts.name: continuum_hypothesis
concepts.definition: |R| = ℵ1? Cohen 1963: independent of ZFC. Substrate analogue: substrate's independence-from-foundation.

concepts.name: category_theory
concepts.definition: Eilenberg + Mac Lane 1945. Objects + morphisms. Compositional reasoning across mathematics. Substrate analogue: substrate's compositional structure framework.

concepts.name: category_definition
concepts.definition: Objects + morphisms (arrows) with composition + identity. Substrate analogue: substrate's typed-arrow framework.

concepts.name: functor
concepts.definition: Morphism between categories. Preserves structure. Substrate analogue: substrate's structure-preserving Mt-map.

concepts.name: natural_transformation
concepts.definition: Morphism between functors. Component-wise compatible. Substrate analogue: substrate's compatible Mt-mappings.

concepts.name: adjoint_functor
concepts.definition: Pair of functors with universal mapping property. Galois connections. Free-forgetful. Substrate analogue: substrate's universal-construction.

concepts.name: monad_category
concepts.definition: Endofunctor with unit + multiplication. Models computation effects. Haskell + category theory. Substrate analogue: substrate's effect-encoding pattern.

concepts.name: foundations_logicism
concepts.definition: Frege + Russell + Whitehead. Mathematics reduces to logic. Principia Mathematica. Substrate analogue: substrate's logic-first foundation.

concepts.name: foundations_formalism
concepts.definition: Hilbert. Mathematics is manipulation of formal symbols. Substrate analogue: substrate's symbol-manipulation framework.

concepts.name: foundations_intuitionism
concepts.definition: Brouwer. Mathematics is mental construction. Rejects excluded middle. Substrate analogue: substrate's constructive framework.

concepts.name: foundations_structuralism
concepts.definition: Mathematics studies structures, not objects. Substrate analogue: substrate's structure-focused foundation.

concepts.name: foundations_platonism
concepts.definition: Mathematical objects exist abstractly. We discover, not invent. Substrate analogue: substrate's discovered-truths view.

concepts.name: computability_theory
concepts.definition: What is effectively computable? Turing machines, lambda calculus, recursive functions. All equivalent. Substrate analogue: substrate's computational-capability theory.

concepts.name: turing_machine
concepts.definition: Turing 1936. Mathematical model of computation. Tape, head, states. Substrate analogue: substrate's universal computation model.

concepts.name: church_turing_thesis
concepts.definition: Effectively computable = Turing-computable. Empirical-mathematical. Substrate analogue: substrate's computation-equivalence.

concepts.name: halting_problem
concepts.definition: Turing 1936. No algorithm decides whether arbitrary program halts. First undecidable problem. Substrate analogue: substrate's behavior-prediction limit.

concepts.name: decidable_problem
concepts.definition: Algorithm decides every instance. Substrate analogue: substrate's tractable problem.

concepts.name: undecidable_problem
concepts.definition: No algorithm decides every instance. Halting, validity in FOL. Substrate analogue: substrate's intractable problem.

concepts.name: recursively_enumerable
concepts.definition: Algorithm lists every member. May not halt on non-members. Halting problem is RE. Substrate analogue: substrate's discoverable but not decidable.

concepts.name: complexity_class
concepts.definition: P, NP, EXPTIME, PSPACE, etc. Resource-bounded computability. Substrate analogue: substrate's resource-classification.

concepts.name: godel_numbering
concepts.definition: Encoding syntax as numbers. Enables arithmetic to talk about itself. Foundation of incompleteness. Substrate analogue: substrate's self-referential encoding.

concepts.name: fixed_point_theorem_logic
concepts.definition: Carnap, Gödel. In sufficient systems, sentence equivalent to claim about itself. G = ¬Prov(G). Substrate analogue: substrate's self-reference construction.

concepts.name: self_reference_paradox
concepts.definition: Liar, Russell, Berry. Self-reference causes contradictions in naïve systems. Substrate analogue: substrate's self-reference handling challenge.

concepts.name: model_existence_theorem
concepts.definition: Henkin. Consistent theory has model. Proof of FOL completeness. Substrate analogue: substrate's satisfiability-from-consistency.

concepts.name: lindstrom_theorem
concepts.definition: FOL is maximally expressive logic with compactness + Löwenheim-Skolem. Substrate analogue: substrate's expressive-optimality.

rules.name: zfc_provides_standard_foundation
rules.head: the substrate works within standard mathematics
rules.body: ZFC set theory provides the foundation. Most mathematics formalizable in ZFC. Substrate's mathematical default.

rules.name: category_theory_unifies_via_structure
rules.head: the substrate compares structures across mathematical domains
rules.body: category theory provides common language via objects + morphisms + composition. Substrate's cross-domain unification.

rules.name: church_turing_bounds_computability
rules.head: the substrate considers what can be computed in principle
rules.body: Church-Turing: effectively computable = Turing-computable. Bounds substrate's potential capabilities.

rules.name: halting_problem_limits_program_analysis
rules.head: the substrate analyzes arbitrary programs
rules.body: halting cannot be decided in general. Many program properties undecidable. Substrate's analysis limit.

rules.name: godel_numbering_enables_self_reference
rules.head: the substrate's formal system is strong enough for arithmetic
rules.body: Gödel numbering encodes syntax as numbers; self-reference becomes possible. Substrate's self-reference construction.
